title: Caching & Cost
motto: Most AI startups do not die from bad models. They die from bad unit economics. A single GPT-4o call costs fractions of a cent. Ten thousand users making ten calls per day costs $250 in input tokens alone -- before you charge a single dollar. The companies that survive are the ones that treat every API call as a financial transaction, not a function call.
